Name: Redesigned Running Dapple Grey Horse
Author: OhHiDinDin
Description:
I really like Zhuria's [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20/?]Dapple Grey Horse[/url] because it looks so pretty. But I didn't like the jelly legs horse and there's this really awesome mod by avalitor [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/261/?]Redesigned Horse Running Animation[/url] so I thought: Why not make a nicely running dapple grey horse?
So I read up on how to edit the .xnb files  for the sprites (which is surprisingly easy) and mashed those two things together.
The brunt of the work was made by Zhuria and avalitor, I only made them meet. Please refer to the original files if you want to edit anything about that.

Available with or without the vanilla saddle.
